intro: Pack-wide settings that are not tied to a single mod card. Fill these in as CampD documents SVM, ReSHADE, and extra folder data.

sections.title: Server Value Modifier
sections.blurb: SVM is the all-in-one server config tool. Document CampD overrides here so players know what is vanilla vs pack-tuned.

groups.title: Items / Inventory
groups.notes: Keys are configured as unbreakable through SVM; no separate Unbreakable Keys mod is needed.

sections.title: ReSHADE
sections.blurb: Visual preset dropped into the SPT root, used alongside Amands's Graphics.

groups.title: Sharper Tushonka Better Life
groups.notes: ReSHADE preset with ReSHADE preinstalled. Drop into root. Works with Amands's Graphics. Turn off sharpen in EFT settings.

sections.title: Extra pack data

groups.notes: Special non-mod folder data ships with this pack in addition to the Forge mod.
